thread:
rachel: Quick sync  CatalystMesh (HW + ISV) + Orchitect want an "edge-to-orch" demo next Thu. Flow: LangChain orchestration -> LlamaIndex retrieval -> our gateway -> Dedicated cluster. Also asking about an Orchitect plugin and a marketplace "Edge Orchestrator" bundle. Who picks what?

Diego: Ill own the LangChain + LlamaIndex wiring. Will run the notebooks and smoke a retrieval + tool-call path. ETA Tue EOD for a smoke summary.

yamir: Ops: need to know if Orchidect/Orchitect will call our streaming endpoint or non-stream. Streaming changes the runbook. Also CatalystMesh staging uses a proxy cert chain; ops-bot, please create a cert acceptance ticket.

hannah: I can prototype the Orchitect plugin adapter (webhook -> /v1/stream). Will aim to land a minimal shim that translates Orchitect task callbacks into our streaming envelope.

ops-bot: Created PARTNER-7033: "CatalystMesh cert bundle + Orchitect shim infra" assigned to @yamir and @hannah.

diego: Found two small risks: 1) LlamaIndex vector-store keys can collide across tenants when Orchitect runs concurrent ingestion. 2) streaming + tool-calls sometimes truncate last token in our current staging runtime. Proposed quick fix for (1): namespace keys per tenant. Snippet to test: ```python
# namespaced key to avoid cross-tenant collisions
def lindex_key(tenant_id, doc_hash):
    return f"catalyst:{tenant_id}:lindex:{doc_hash}"
```

yamir: For the streaming flakiness, ops can schedule a 60-min maintenance window to push a retry wrapper in the gateway. Suggested Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Rollback: revert gateway config and switch traffic to fallback model if error rate > 0.8% in 5 minutes.

hannah: Plugin note: Orchitect expects synchronous 2xx for task callbacks; our shim will ack quickly and fan-out to /v1/stream. Will include exponential backoff for webhook retries.

legal-bot: Reminder: co-announcement requires signed co-marketing addendum. Filing COANN-4178. Typical review 48-72 hours.

rachel: Timeline suggestion: Tue EOD smoke report, Tue night gateway push (Yamir), Wed 09:00 internal dry run, Thu 13:00 partner demo. If legal not ready, do embargoed demo.

diego: Quick local streaming curl for folks to validate: ```bash
curl -N -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEV" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-stream-1","input":"call tool:extract_entities"}'
```

yamir: Ill post the maintenance checklist and rollback steps once confirmed with infra. Ops will monitor p95 latency and error rate during the window.

hannah: Ill open the Orchitect adapter repo and post a deploy checklist + demo script by Tue midday.

rachel: Action owners: Diego -> LangChain/LlamaIndex tests + namespacing; Yamir -> gateway push + maintenance & rollback; Hannah -> Orchitect shim + deploy checklist; Legal-bot -> COANN-4178 review. Ill coordinate CatalystMesh time slots. Keep updates here and flag blockers ASAP. :white_check_mark:
